notes: 9/2023 EKM 1. melléklet 3.1.2 permits window-based ventilation or, when ventilation is not solved by windows, regulated central/decentral exhaust or heat-recovery ventilation. Exhaust requires air-inlet elements.
Current EKR section 2.8 computes heat-recovery savings from 0.35*V*c*n_required*(eta_new-eta_old); P88 therefore applies eta only to the required-air term and not to uncontrolled infiltration.

EU 1253/2014 Annex IV requires residential ventilation product information to state HRS type and thermal efficiency. The declared value can bind a selected product but is not an observed national distribution or installed commissioning result.
14/14 P87 strata decompose H_required_air=0.35*0.5*V. At eta=1 this is the maximum recoverable required-air coefficient before infiltration.
P88 separates H_infiltration=0.35*n_filt*V. The upper edge uses the P87 official method-domain n_filt=1.0 and maximum P85 volume; no airtightness class is assigned to the programme population.
Post-retrofit ventilation path is controlled by programme/project design. National scenario weights may be propagated explicitly but are not evidence about existing or future observed prevalence.

The response engine needs eta only when the HRV path is selected. Product-level declared eta is available by regulation; a national post-retrofit eta distribution is not a prerequisite for scenario execution.

Ventilation-system path assignment is executable and may be programmatic. Envelope/window actions still do not prove post-retrofit infiltration, so infiltration target/test/bounded inference remains fail-closed.
P88 makes natural, mechanical-exhaust and HRV thermal response executable on all 14 P87 strata without inventing path shares or eta distributions.

P88 retires post-retrofit ventilation-path prevalence and HRV-efficiency-distribution as population-evidence blockers. Infiltration assignment remains the ventilation residual; total B06 design load remains partial.
